Name: ReGen Valley -  Realistic Dirt to Soil Farming System
Author: robertsvalley
Description:
[size=4][b]Ever want to do realistic farming based on soil building instead of soil destruction?

[/b]Your soil should be like moist chocolate cake, not dusty and crusty.

[/size]Old Style: Till → Plant → Harvest → Repeat
New Style: Cover Crop → Graze → Roll → Plant → Graze → Restore → Expand. Farming becomes more intentional, with ecological feedback and a strategic component similar to permaculture planning.[size=4][u]

Example of how to get started in-game:[/u][/size]

[size=4]1. Read Grampa's book. This gifts you all the items you need.[/size]
2. Place free chest and store items.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764656274-857274226.gif[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764660212-316530243.gif[/img]

[size=4]4. Craft temporary fence. First plastic roll is inside your inventory after reading Grampa's book. Pierre sells more.[/size]
[size=4]5. Clear area and construct a pen with gate. You can mix and match normal fencing if you are short fencing or gates. The benefit of the temporary fence recipe is that it can always be broken and reused.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764660223-1180426878.gif[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764660820-1148379840.gif[/img]


[size=4]6.[u] Lure cows[/u] to your pen with the feed bucket.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764660898-1992238636.gif[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764660910-1471814554.gif[/img]
[/size]
[size=3]7. [/size][size=4]Craft a glorious stud cow beacon and place it[/size] [size=5]in the middle of the pen [u]near cows[/u]. [/size][size=3]T[/size][size=4]he cows will snap to it as their new[/size]
[size=4]anchor. The beacon must be in a central location or cows get stuck! [u]bug: the cows have to be close to the beacon to be anchored. you can remake the beacon and re-try if you miss.[/u]
[/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764660956-978345968.gif[/img]

[size=4]8. Use the no-till planter with the 10 cover seeds in your inventory. They take 3 days to mature and the cows will graze 1 per day. Pierre sells more.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764300131-2107574557.jpg[/img]
[/size]
[size=4]9. Plan ahead and build multiple pens. After the cows are done in one pen, lure them to the next pen and shut the gate. Build a new glorious stud beacon to anchor them into their new area.

[size=4]10. Plant cash crops (parsnips, corn, pumpkin, powdermelon) in the pens after the cows are done eating cover crops in it.

[/size]Gunther gives out 2 soil test kits a day for free so you can see how the soil improved. Baseline soil health is 25.0.

[size=4]Reap the rewards of your hard work with improved soil health = improved harvest![/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39740/39740-1764660248-349636998.gif[/img]
[/size]

[b][size=4]In-Depth Mechanics:[/size][/b]

It is per tile so the grazed or rolled tiles will have the bonuses. No penalties for mixing vanilla till growth, it is just the vanilla rates.

[b]Water perks[/b] kick in per tile at Health > 80
A healthy tile can keep water for an extra day. A good rain on healthy soil lets you skip watering for 2 days after.
[b]
Faster growth [/b]kicks in per tile at 70+ / 90+
At 70+ Soil Health: crops on those tiles effectively grow an extra day each night. At 90+: they get up to two extra days of growth per night on those tiles.

[b]Yield & quality[/b] kick in [u]farm-wide[/u] at avg 75+ / 90+Your harvests get bigger and better overall.

When your whole farm’s tilled soil averages 75+:
Fruit/veg/fiber come in with[b] higher quality[/b] and about +10% more yield.
At 90+ farm average: expect lots more gold/iridium and around +25% more yield.



🌱 ReGen Valley – From Dirt to Soil [i]A Regenerative Farming Expansion for Stardew Valley [/i][b]Inspired by Dan Brown’s “Dirt to Soil,” this mod transforms traditional farming into a living ecosystem.[/b] ReGen Valley introduces real-world regenerative agriculture systems such as rotational grazing, cover crops, soil health tracking, and adaptive farm planning. It rewards players for farming [b]with the land—not  against it.[/b][line]📌 Core Features🐄 [b]Dynamic Grazing System[/b][list]
[*]Use the Feed Bucket to guide cows to new paddocks.
[*]Place Cow Beacons to establish grazing paddocks.
[*]Cows graze cover crops, improving soil health over time.
[*][b]Automatic night-pen return system[/b] brings them home safely.
[/list][line]🌾 [b]Cover Crop Integration[/b][list]
[*]Plant soil-enhancing cover crops such as [b]Rye, Clover, Sorghum, Buckwheat[/b] (plus seasonal variants).
[*]Each cover crop improves different soil metrics (water retention, organic matter, nutrient cycling).
[*]Random grazing events simulate natural pasture evolution.
[*]Roller-Tool crimps cover crops without grazing to add soil armor and carbon.
[/list][line]🚜 [b]New Farming Tools
[/b]
[b]Roller [/b]Terminates cover crops and prepares fields.
[b]No-Till Planter [/b]Allows crop planting without disturbing soil.
[b]Feed Bucket  [/b]Drives cow movement toward beacons.
[b]Temporary Fencing [/b]Quickly build and break paddock barriers.[/table][line]🌍 [b]Soil Health Simulation[/b][list]
[*]Tracks soil organic matter, moisture, and biological activity per tile.
[*]Regeneration or decline based on farming style and grazing pressure.
[*]HUD summaries give daily regenerative insights.
[*]Long-term improvement boosts crop quality over seasons and improve chance at high quality crops.
[/list][line]🔁 Gameplay Philosophy This mod is built around the [b]5 Principles of Regenerative Agriculture:[/b][list=1]
[*]Limit soil disturbance
[*]Keep soil covered
[*]Maintain living roots
[*]Integrate animals
[*]Increase diversity
[/list]Players who rotate grazing, maintain cover crops, and reduce tilling will experience sustained yields and healthier farms over time.[line]📊 New Farm Progression Loop
[b]Old Style:[/b] Till → Plant → Harvest → Repeat
[b]New Style:[/b] Cover Crop → Graze → Roll → Plant → Graze → Restore → ExpandFarming becomes more [b]intentional[/b], with [b]ecological feedback[/b] and a strategic component similar to permaculture planning.[line]🎮 Compatibility & Requirements[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.x[/b]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b]
[*]Multiplayer-compatible (though early testing is ongoing)
[*]Does not alter vanilla NPC schedules or seasonal restrictions
[/list][line]📅 Future Additions (Work In Progress)[list]
[*]

Chickens- chicken tractor (grazing) and chicken poo
Briquet Press - i.e. compress chicken/biomatter into fuel bricks [/size][/b]
